data.name: Carbo Culture
data.description: Carbo Culture takes waste biomass and transforms it using patented reactors, producing biochar for agricultural and construction applications, generating renewable energy, and creating carbon credits. The Finland/Netherlands-active company is building the ARC Middenmeer biochar plant at the ECW Energy site in North Holland, expected to remove more than 20,000 tonnes of CO2 annually while producing 40,000 m³ of biochar and 16 MW of sustainable energy.
